_comment: F8 stability pinned (RFC §5.8): same as problem-published-vehicle-stability-unhinted but shipment 7 carries published_vehicle=1 + published_vehicle_cost=300. Without the hint, V2=[8,7] at 6500 wins (shipment 7 migrates). With the hint, V2=[8,7] now costs 6500 + 300 = 6800 vs V1=[7,8] at 6700 + 0 = 6700, so V1=[7,8] wins. Shipment 7 STAYS on its hinted vehicle even though V2 would otherwise be cheaper by 200. This is the M8 acceptance criterion — solver-integrated stability, NOT post-solve labeling. If a future change breaks the hot-path wiring (e.g., reverts the trim of route.cost += in apply_published_vehicle_pass, or skips one of the eval-site edits in src/utils/helpers.h / helpers.cpp), this fixture's recorded cost shifts back to 6800 with deviation=300 — regression script catches it.
